title: Mary
creator: CrossFit
description: As many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of 5 handstand push-ups, 10 alternating pistols and 15 pull-ups. Introduced in 2004 as the advanced sibling of Cindy; the same time domain but with three high-skill gymnastics movements. Scale to pike push-ups, box pistols and ring rows.
